total_model.summary: Model projects 49.9 total points (BUF 30, BAL 20). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 3.1), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (lowers total 1.8), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
